items.title: US court backs Bybit’s bid to trace funds from $1.5B North Korea hack
items.snippet: Expedited discovery allows the exchange to seek account identities, balances and transaction histories from platforms with US operations.

items.title: New XRP Ledger amendments target $530 million in tokenized Wall Street assets
items.snippet: A new XRPL amendment proposal would let institutions encrypt token balances and transfer amounts while still giving issuers, auditors and regulators selective access.

items.title: Bitcoin holders risk losing real BTC if they sell coins from BIP-110 fork, says developer
items.snippet: If a minority chain appears this weekend, buyers could replay signed fork-coin sales on bitcoin itself, making doing nothing the safest move until the chains can be separated.
